recognize_zh: 掃描倍率下為一整顆淋巴結，被膜完整、周圍有脂肪，實質內可見許多小濾泡與生發中心，整體架構大致保留；在這個倍率下看不出腫瘤細胞，需要高倍或 HHV8 染色才能看到竇內的大型細胞。
features: Entire oval lymph node with intact fibrous capsule and perinodal adipose tissue
Largely preserved architecture with numerous small follicles and germinal centers
Some follicles appear small or regressed with prominent mantle zones
Subtle sinus pattern; no mass-forming effacement at scanning power
Linear cutting/folding artifacts across the section
describe_en: Scanning-power H&E section shows an entire lymph node with an intact fibrous capsule and perinodal fat. The nodal architecture is largely preserved, with numerous small follicles, some with small or regressed germinal centers, and no mass-forming effacement. Sinusoidal involvement by large neoplastic cells is not resolvable at this magnification, and linear sectioning artifacts are present. This field alone would not suggest lymphoma; the diagnosis of extracavitary primary effusion lymphoma relies on higher-power identification of large cells within sinuses and HHV8 immunostaining.

ddx.vs: Similar preserved architecture at low power; lacks sinusoidal clusters of large HHV8-positive cells at higher power.
Shows regressed follicles with expanded mantle zones and interfollicular plasma cells, with HHV8-positive plasmablasts in mantle zones rather than sinus sheets.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma, sinusoidal pattern
ddx.vs: Can also spare architecture at low power; large cells are CD30/ALK or T-cell positive and HHV8-negative.
